name: Temporal
line: Durable workflow engine that resumes jobs, retries activities, and schedules work.

free.text: $150 credits/90d; no idle pause; closed-workflow retention is configurable

cells.regions: 14 AWS and 6 GCP regions; availability varies

sql.math: Temporal orchestrates workflows; it is not a database
Temporal orchestrates workflows; it is not a database

files.math: Temporal does not provide file storage

jobs.math: 10,000 jobs do not turn into Actions without workflow steps. Cloud starts at $50 per million Actions, and worker hosting is separate.
